newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sixt sees sales climbing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Sixt sees sales climbing in 1997.

text.p: German car rental company Sixt AG said on Monday it expects higher sales and a more than corresponding increase in group operating profit in 1997.
Looking ahead, the group said it expects sales to rise to four billion marks by the year 2000 and predicted a similar increase in profits.

The company said in its annual report that the first quarter result for leasing and rentals had grown at a double-digit pace. In 1996, Sixt reported sales of 2.11 billion marks and operating profit was 46.28 million marks.
